summary: Iteration 92 - Gallery, Lightbox, Admin Reviews CRUD, Room Photo Upload Testing Complete. All 20 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: Gallery section with 6 images in asymmetric grid, fullscreen lightbox with prev/next navigation, caption and counter (1/6), close button. Admin reviews CRUD (create/list/delete) working with auth. Room photo upload endpoints working. Full booking flow works. Mobile responsive.

tests: 6 gallery images displayed in asymmetric grid (first image larger)
Gallery adapts to 2-column grid on mobile
GET /api/booking-widget/reviews/{property_id} returns reviews list with auth
POST /api/booking-widget/reviews creates review with id, guest_name, rating, etc.
Deleted review no longer appears in list
POST /api/booking-widget/room-photo/{room_id} uploads photo and returns URL
Each image has url, caption, type fields
Returns default 6 images when no custom photos
Search → Results → Checkout → Confirmation flow works
Guest form accepts name, email, phone, special requests
Booking summary shows correct pricing (£200 for 2 nights)
Gallery adapts to 2-column grid on mobile
Lightbox works on mobile with touch navigation

Lightbox uses React state for index management with modulo for circular navigation
Admin reviews CRUD properly protected with require_roles('admin', 'manager')

Gallery API aggregates room photos, room gallery arrays, and property_gallery collection
Default 6 Unsplash/Pexels images returned when no custom photos uploaded
